sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the toolchain, then build and run a project with Gradle

snippets.code:
# Install the compiler and runner with SDKMAN
sdk install kotlin 2.2.0

# Confirm the version on the PATH
kotlin -version

# Produce a self-contained jar
kotlinc Main.kt -include-runtime -d app.jar

# Launch it on any Java 17 or newer runtime
java -jar app.jar

# Scaffold a Kotlin application with the Gradle Kotlin DSL
gradle init --type kotlin-application --dsl kotlin --project-name demo --package demo

# Compile and run the application entry point
./gradlew run

# Run the tests and open the HTML report
./gradlew test
xdg-open build/reports/tests/test/index.html

sections.title: Types
sections.description: Built-in value types, explicit conversions, aliases, and smart casts

snippets.code:
fun main() {
    val count: Int = 12
    val ratio: Double = 0.75
    val active: Boolean = true
    val grade: Char = 'A'
    val note: String = "ready"

    // Kotlin never widens numbers implicitly.
    val widened: Long = count.toLong()
    val truncated: Int = 3.9.toInt()      // 3
    val parsed: Int = "2048".toInt()
    val text: String = count.toString()

    println(listOf(widened, truncated, parsed, text, ratio, active, grade, note))
}

sections.title: Data Classes
sections.description: Value semantics from copy, equality, and destructuring

snippets.code:
data class User(val id: Long, val name: String, val active: Boolean = true)

fun main() {
    val ada = User(1, "Ada")
    val renamed = ada.copy(name = "Ada Lovelace")

    println(ada)            // User(id=1, name=Ada, active=true)
    println(renamed.name)   // Ada Lovelace
    println(renamed == ada) // false

    val (id, name) = renamed
    println("$id / $name")  // 1 / Ada Lovelace
}

sections.title: Collections
sections.description: Read-only and mutable lists, sets, and maps with their usual operations

snippets.code:
fun main() {
    val names = listOf("ada", "grace", "alan")
    val scores = mapOf("ada" to 98, "grace" to 91)
    val tags = mutableSetOf("jvm", "android")

    tags.add("server")

    println(names[1])                            // grace
    println(scores["alan"] ?: 0)                 // 0
    println(names.firstOrNull { it.length > 4 }) // grace
    println(tags)                                // [jvm, android, server]
}

snippets.code:
fun String.initials(): String =
    split(" ").filter { it.isNotBlank() }.map { it.first() }.joinToString("")

fun Int.isEven(): Boolean = this % 2 == 0

fun main() {
    println("Ada Lovelace".initials()) // AL
    println(7.isEven())                // false
}
